purpose: Owner review of Number Lab's visual code redesign: shape carries family (angular clipped-square Family A, round lotus Family B), one large dominant categorical colour plate per tile carries tier (same hue in both families), a dark medallion with a white numeral confirms, and a cyan/white glow is reserved for selected/placeable/merge-ready state only.
selection: Every file here is copied from number-lab-app/'s runtime ship list; service-worker.js is omitted and the registration call in index.html has been neutralised so the staged copy registers no service worker.
publishStatus: Not publishable: number-lab-app has no destination in release/registry.json and no deployment repository. This is a staging preview only.
